t: About Us - Trent Austin Design
s: October 26, 2025 - We select materials not only for their aesthetic appeal but for their durability and performance, creating pieces designed to weather daily use while developing character over time. Our artisans and craftspeople bring decades of collective experience to their work, with specialized knowledge in woodworking, metalcraft, upholstery, and finishing techniques. Many of our manufacturing processes are done by hand, preserving the human touch that mass production often lacks. This dedication to craftsmanship means that every Trent Austin Design® piece carries with it the pride and expertise of its makers.
